contexts.text: The sons of Javan... Elishah, etc. () = those who had external worship derived from that which existed with the nation Javan... Elishah, etc., were so many nations, with whom there was such worship; and by which also are signified so many doctrinal things, which were rituals, derived from the external worship with Javan. AC 1156.
Blue and purple from the isles of Elishah () = rituals corresponding to internal worship. AC 2576:8.
Blue and purple from the isles of Elishah = the intelligence of truth and good.
